name: hybrid_centerfusion_v1
_arm: LR-ASPP/CenterFusion hybrid: 3-channel RGB stem + shallow 4-channel radar encoder, feature-level fusion, 1/4-resolution CenterNet detection branch with radar-conditioned XYZ/dims/yaw refinement
_controlled_against_baseline: every optimizer, schedule, augmentation, loss-weight and target setting below is curriculum_stage2_joint_v1's verbatim, so the only changed variable is the architecture
_epoch_numbering_note: offset 1 so epoch_001.pt is the first trained epoch and epoch_006.pt is the sixth; 'epoch 6' in the gate means exactly six warm-started epochs
_init_object_checkpoint_note: empty on purpose: the hybrid builder performs the whole warm start (backbone stem split, classifier, split-heatmap object head) and records the mapping in warm_start_mapping.json
_selection_note: logged only; promotion is decoded-metric selection outside training
